title.narrative: Private Sector Development: Business Link Pacific Phase II

description.narrative: BLP Phase II supports Pacific small to medium enterprise (SME) development by facilitating access to quality, affordable and local business advice and finance. BLP II aims to build on the achievements of Phase I with an enhanced focus on climate resilience and economic inclusion of vulnerable groups such as women, youth, rural and indigenous businesses.
